question: whether the memory growth of a reachable node levels off once Kad entries start expiring
conditions: rc.2, no dashboard, no polling of any kind, UPnP mappings on, eD2K server and Kad connected, sampled every 5 min
finding: it does not level off within 30 h. Both runs keep climbing at roughly 1.5 MiB/h from hour 12 to the end, with handles and threads flat, the reachability API available in every sample and a clean shutdown that withdrew every mapping. The Kad indexes written at exit grow in step but account for about a tenth of the growth
not_measured: whether upstream eMule 0.70b behaves the same; that comparison needs a vanilla build and has not been run
